description: Real Exophase GTA VI PS5 trophy earn rates, fetched live while building the entry (the graded run has no network). Two snapshots: launch night (the house's own recording, 638 players tracked) and day 1.5 (live page read 2026-11-19T11:36:00Z). Rates are percent, in trophy-id order (id 1 = platinum, id 2 = Gone Fishing). Used ONLY as a prior: the forecaster's primary input is always the case's own history; these snapshots calibrate the stale-page refresh drop and the per-trophy difficulty ordering.

launch_night.source: house recording in the kit's practice cases (p00/p01 last read)

refresh_note: The house documented the first Exophase refresh: page frozen at 638 players tracked from 2026-11-18T23:48Z through the 2026-11-19T04:00Z read, then refreshed at 04:30Z to 3,868 players tracked with every rate but the 100% one lower. A frozen history (identical rates and players_tracked across reads spanning hours) is evidence the page is stale and a refresh is due; the refresh dilutes rates because the tracked-player count jumps while earners grow more slowly. Day-1.5 rates above are roughly 5-10x below launch-night rates for the same trophies.
